title: The Cold Signal
author: Edmund Crane
blurb: Ivo Quintana, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
